stdio.purpose: Independent short-lived operator supervisor; exiting saves/closes workers. Tested.

proxy.purpose: Independent clients share persistent local supervisor/worker pool; auto-spawns daemon with file lock.

required_routing: open_database(database_id=<unique-id>, file_path=<isolated-input-clone>, run_auto_analysis=false, force_new=false). Every subsequent tool must receive database=<same-id>. Each agent should own a separate cached project for writes.
preload_path: <cloned-input-parent>/ghidra_projects/<cloned-input-basename>.gpr and .rep, containing root program named <cloned-input-basename>. Existing B project cloning verified.
macOS_state: ~/Library/Application Support/re-mcp-ghidra/daemon.json; XDG_STATE_HOME has no effect on macOS. Do not expose daemon authentication token.
important_limits: Existing upstream package was locally patched; preserve ghidra-project-save.patch when upgrading.
stdio and shared proxy have same native tool surface (33 pinned/discovery tools), so use on-demand SDK operator to avoid duplicate global schemas.
Persistent projects can be locked by one worker; separate APFS clones per writer avoid this. Do not open original release directory or master project for writes.
Raw .gpr as input was not tested; use prepared binary path and matching preloaded project naming.
